description: Use when adding database storage, implementing key-value persistence, or integrating SQL databases in Tauri 2 apps. Prevents data loss from missing store auto-save configuration and SQL injection from unparameterized queries. Covers SQLite via tauri-plugin-sql, key-value storage via tauri-plugin-store, and custom DB integration with sqlx/diesel/rusqlite. Keywords: tauri database, SQLite, tauri-plugin-sql, tauri-plugin-store, key-value storage, sqlx, diesel, rusqlite.
